CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2632 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head edc3158d23d19fa9270edaab06293c1ee5a92299. Bus nonce: 8ef895202d8d2525c53ef3fd69926f7b. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin edc3158d23d19fa9270edaab06293c1ee5a92299`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge edc3158d23d19fa9270edaab06293c1ee5a92299` or `Fix review: blocked edc3158d23d19fa9270edaab06293c1ee5a92299 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 8ef895202d8d2525c53ef3fd69926f7b`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2632 edc3158d23d19fa9270edaab06293c1ee5a92299") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2632-8ef89520`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer (adversarial, opus) for PR #2632, group R10-LOOP-CPU, round 4, head edc3158d23d19fa9270edaab06293c1ee5a92299. LOOP-CPU is on the critical path: R10-LIVESTATE waits on it. Read the group with jq from origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json (its brief, carry and resume), and read the earlier verdicts on review/2632 and verdict/2632 plus the PR's review comments. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head, using the FINDER's harness that the group brief names, never the fixer's. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head (ev/HEAD.txt), or the relay refuses the verdict.

Round 4 change: a fast keystone check pins the mutant that timed out in round 3. The head also merges the bot's mutation-pin commit a1fb830e; the only conflict was the _expire_away_override RETURN_DEL killed_by file, resolved to a1fb830e's version.

Verify:
(1) Every round-3 block is settled at this head. The keystone check goes red under the timed-out mutant, and the mutant now dies within its budget, not by timeout.
(2) Off the event loop: the away recovery estimate and the interval replay no longer run on the loop. Show it with the finder's harness at the base and at the head, plus a null control (a flat-price or idle-input run) in which the measured CPU delta is 0.
(3) archscore WORSENS: the body states dS +0.1687 (coord_footprint 2489 -> 2491). Re-run tools/audit/archscore/ at the merge base and at the head, and judge whether the body's justification holds or whether a sounder placement exists. That is a finding with a Carry if it does not hold. structure.py must pass at the head, with budgets no higher than main's.
(4) Two items from review 6354822998 are unrouted by carry_audit: 9b5e6fd8 ("CI is not settled at this head", evidence about an older head) and 325975e1 ("Round 1's two dismissed findings stand", HASTUB_TZ=Europe/Stockholm failures at the base). State in your verdict whether each still applies at this head. Then either route it with a Carry, or put it under Evidence with the reason, so carry_audit reaches 0 unrouted once your verdict is in.
(5) The mutation_ledger merge is byte-equal to a1fb830e: the diff from a1fb830e to the head over tests/mutation_ledger is empty. The scoped gate MODE line. CI from one bulk check-runs read. The merge-tree against origin/main is clean. VERSION is untouched. Commits carry no footers.
